metadata.title: FizzBuzz with an elif Chain
metadata.description: Print Fizz, Buzz, or FizzBuzz for 1..n using a single if/elif chain so exactly one line prints per number.

instructions.main: Set `n = 15` and print FizzBuzz for 1..n: multiples of 15 print `FizzBuzz`, multiples of 3 print `Fizz`, multiples of 5 print `Buzz`, everything else prints the number — exactly one line per number.
steps: Use one `if`/`elif` chain so only one branch runs per number.
Check divisibility by 15 FIRST, then 3, then 5.

hints.message: Start with `for i in range(1, n + 1):` and an `if i % 15 == 0:` branch.
Separate `if` statements each run on their own — chain them with `elif` so only one branch prints per number.
Check `i % 15` FIRST in the chain — later `elif` branches never run when an earlier condition already matched.
Compare your output with the expected transcript — one wrong branch or an extra line usually means the checks are in the wrong order or not chained with elif.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: Your elif chain prints exactly one correct line per number.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: The full FizzBuzz transcript matches exactly.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Compare each line with the expected transcript — check the order of your divisibility tests and that only one line prints per number.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: You used an if/elif chain with at least two branches.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Use an `if`/`elif` chain (at least two branches) rather than unrelated statements.
